--- title: "Modeling and Predicting YouTube Engagement" subtitle: "INFO 523 - Summer 2025 - Final Project" author: Ashok kumar Marimuthu title-slide-attributes: data-background-image: images/youtube-analytics-bg.png data-background-size: stretch data-background-opacity: "0.7" data-slide-number: none format: revealjs: theme: ['data/customtheming.scss'] editor: visual jupyter: python3 execute: echo: false --- ## What & Why **What are we solving?**
Can we predict whether a YouTube video will get high engagement using just its metadata`?`{=html} ::::: columns ::: {.column width="70%"} **Why does it matter?**\ - ⏰ Timing, title, and early traction can make a huge difference\ - 🧑‍🏫 Creators can optimize effort and boost visibility\ - 📈 Modeling can guide strategy and platform recommendati`ons`{=html} ::: ::: {.column width="30%"} ![](images/youtube_chart_clean.jpg){width="100%"} ::: ::::: ## How We Approached It :::: columns ::: {.column width="100%"} - 🧹 Cleaned and explored video metadata\ - 🛠️ Engineered features: `title_length`, `upload_hour`, `like_ratio`, `duration_minutes`\ - 🎯 Framed task as binary classification (top 25% views = high engagement)\ - 🤖 Trained Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and **XGBoost** - 🧪 Compared using Accuracy and ROC-AUC ::: :::: ## The Dataset - 📦 **Source:** India YouTube Trending Video Dataset (Kaggle) - 📊 **Size:** 251,277 rows across 16 columns \~78,847 unique videos - 🛠️ Key Features Used: - title_length - upload_hour - like_ratio - trending_days - duration_minutes (from API subset) 🔍 Focused only on metadata available before a video trends ## EDA Insight: When to Upload? ::: {.column width="100%"} - 🌙 Highest average views are for videos uploaded **between midnight and 3 AM** - 🌅 View counts steadily drop during the day and hit a **low in the evening** - 📌 Upload timing may impact visibility - uploading early may improve reach ::: ## {.no-title-slide} ::: {.columns .align-middle} ::: {.column width="80%"} ![](images/views_by_hour_clean.png){width="100%" .center} ::: ::: {.column width="20%"} ![](images/views_by_hour_image.png){width="100%"} ::: ::: ## EDA Insight 2 – Title Length vs. View Count ::: {.column width="100%"} 📌 **Insight:**\ - **Longer titles** (91–120 characters) get the most views\ - **Very short titles** (31–60) perform the worst\ - **0–30 and 61–90** ranges perform moderately well
💡 **Takeaway:**\ Longer, descriptive titles may help a video attract more engagement ::: ## {.no-title-slide} ![](images/title_length_vs_views.png) ## Modeling Summary ::: {.column width="60%"} [ 🧠 **Models Tried:** ]{style="font-size: 80%;"} [ - Logistic Regression\ - Decision Tree\ - Random Forest\ - XGBoost (with hyperparameter tuning) ]{style="font-size: 75%;"} ::: ::: {.column width="30%"} [ 🏆 **Top Performer: XGBoost**\ ]{style="font-size: 85%;"} [ - ROC AUC: **0.85**\ - Accuracy: **0.78** ]{style="font-size: 80%;"} ::: ::: {style="text-align: center;"} ![](images/model_summary.png){height="350px"} ::: ## Evaluation Highlights ::::: columns ::: {.column .bordered width="45%"} 📊 **Tuned XGBoost using RandomizedSearchCV**\ - `max_depth = 7`\ - `n_estimators = 200`\ - `learning_rate = 0.2`\ - `scale_pos_weight = 3` ::: ::: {.column width="40%"} 📈 **Class 1 Performance**\ - Precision: **0.55**\ - Recall: **0.74**\ - ROC AUC: **0.85**\ - Accuracy: **0.78** ::: 🧠 XGBoost balances depth and learning rate to handle imbalanced labels effectively.\ 📌 High recall on positive class helps flag trending videos better.\ 🎯 Still room to improve precision using advanced tuning. ::::: ## {.no-title-slide} ![Model ROC Curve Comparison](images/roc_comparison.png){width="100%"} ## Key Takeaways & Reflection - 📊 Metadata alone (like title, upload hour, like ratio) has strong predictive value - 🕗 Upload hour and 📏 title length showed clear patterns during EDA - 🧠 XGBoost delivered the best results (ROC AUC: **0.85**) after tuning - ⚖️ We addressed class imbalance and refined noisy engagement signals - 📎 Extra features like video duration (via API) supported richer insights ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## What I Learned ::: {.column width="60%"} - 🧪 Combining datasets improved both context and quality
- 🧹 Feature engineering can be more impactful than just model choice
- 📦 Reproducible workflows (like Quarto + Jupyter) made storytelling smoother ::: ::: {.column width="30%"} ![](images/what_I_learned.png) ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## What’s Next ::: {.column width="60%"} - 🔄 Try deeper model tuning and ensemble techniques - 💬 Use NLP to analyze video titles and tags - 📈 Apply model suggestions to real-world content strategy ::: ::: {.column width="30%"} ![](images/whats_next.png) :::
